info.name: APZHUB Law Platform API v1
info.description: Canonical OpenAPI specification for the tenant-scoped Law Platform REST API. Base path `/api/law/v1/`. Business resources (Clients through Invoices) are implemented. Interactive docs at `/api/docs`.
